result.title: What Does Hard-Negative Fine-Tuning Teach Multimodal Large Language Models? Controlled Evidence from a Compositional Benchmark
result.summary: Fine-tuning on hard negatives is a popular way to improve the compositional reasoning of vision-language models, but when accuracy goes up it is rarely clear what the model actually learned. We ask this question for multimodal large language models. We use CompHall, 2,860 forced-choice questions (spatial, attribute, counting and part-whole) with two graded hard negatives each, three model families (LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT and Idefics2), and controls that such studies often lack: gray-image evaluation, three seeds, option-order tests, control arms trained on different question types, and independent benchmarks. We find four things. First, CompHall is not a pure test of vision: part-whole questions can be answered from the text alone (66-95% without the image), and per-image accuracy is unrelated to an object-hallucination probe (r = -0.05), so we see no evidence that compositional failures drive hallucination. Second, the original fine-tuning method scored mostly image-placeholder tokens and hurt both LLaVA models. With a corrected loss, fine-tuning raises accuracy on the spatial-relation questions of CV-Bench in all three families, by +3.2, +23.1 and +6.0 points (averaged over both option orders). Control arms show that the gain needs spatial training questions, and for LLaVA-NeXT about two-thirds of it appears even on relation words that were only wrong options in training. Third, the gain is not general: on CompHall itself it is significant only for LLaVA-NeXT (+6.9 points) and not detectable for Idefics2, it reaches about 3 points at most on true/false statements, and LLaVA-1.5 fine-tuned on other question types learns to answer "true" too often. Fourth, both losses raise the yes-bias of LLaVA-1.5 on POPE.

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建 CompHall（2,860 道强制选择题，覆盖空间、属性、计数、部分-整体，每题含两个分级 hard negatives），在 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、Idefics2 上系统检验 hard-negative 微调究竟让模型学到了什么，并以灰图评测、多随机种子、选项顺序测试、不同类型题目对照臂和独立基准作为控制。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于 VLM 视觉推理的诊断与失败分析：指出部分-整体题可脱离图像作答、增益高度依赖空间题型且集中在关系词、并伴随 yes-bias，直接关联 LVR 关注的视觉证据使用、增益归因与训练监督设计；其灰图与文本-only 控制可供核查 latent 状态是否真正依赖视觉输入。
